title: Lévy structure of the forward fixed-coupling BFKL kernel and a fixed-order obstruction to positivity in the symmetric scheme
summary: We establish a Levy interpretation of normalized forward BFKL small-$x$ evolution at leading order and fixed coupling, and exclude a probability law at fixed-order next-to-leading accuracy in the symmetric scheme. After the Marchesini-Onofri conjugation and growth subtraction, one positive step measure in closed form covers all conformal spins, on the cylinder of logarithmic transverse momentum and azimuth.
